note: Compact rule index. Prose lives at each rule's `source`; this file is what agents and scripts load. `status` is the promotion ramp: proposed -> approved (advisory, surfaces as P2) -> enforced (blocking). `check` names a function in scripts/standards_check.py; rules without one are enforced by /review.

META-001.text: Every rule sourced from a *_STYLE.md document MUST appear there as an [ID] marker, and every [ID] marker in a *_STYLE.md document MUST exist in docs/standards/rules.json.

OPS-001.text: Documented or scripted `bun run migrate` invocations MUST set DATABASE_URL explicitly; a bare invocation from apps/api targets the hosted production database.

OPS-002.text: `uv run --with <tool>` MUST pass --no-project; without it the command rebuilds the shared model/.venv.

PY-001.text: CLI default paths MUST be anchored to __file__, never relative to the current working directory, because `just` recipes change CWD.

RES-001.text: Every whole_piece reference constant in a claim-verifier measurer MUST record the (transcriber x corpus) pair it was calibrated on in apps/evals/claim_taxonomy/reference_calibration.json, and that transcriber MUST be the active transcription substrate. A stale reference does not fail loudly: the signed d stays computable and the router stays confident while the faithfulness rate silently collapses (#101 FRONT 9 measured dynamics 0.979 -> 0.236 on one stale line; FRONT 10 measured articulation 0.950 -> 0.438).
RES-001.promotion_note: Advisory, NOT enforced: dynamics REFERENCE_VELOCITY (aria-amt, 51.5) and pedaling REFERENCE_FRACTION (aria-amt, 0.4623) are live violations left standing on purpose. Their recalibrated values are measured (64.33 and 0.5798 on transkun/MAESTRO) but shipping them changes production verdicts, which is an owner decision. Promote to enforced once those two land.

TS-WRK-001.text: Worker code MUST read configuration from c.env or the fetch handler env, never process.env.

TS-HONO-001.text: Validators and handler MUST be chained in a single expression; a separate handler function loses Hono RPC type inference.

TS-HONO-002.text: AppType MUST be exported from the chained .route() result, not from the base app.

TS-HONO-003.text: CF service bindings MUST NOT be destructured from c.env; they lose their `this` context and throw Illegal invocation.

TS-HONO-004.text: Request-scoped data MUST NOT be stored in module-level variables; isolates are reused across requests.

TS-HONO-005.text: zValidator MUST be given an error hook returning JSON; the default response is plain text.

TS-HONO-006.text: SSE responses MUST set Content-Encoding: Identity or wrangler dev buffers the stream.

TS-HONO-007.text: Routes that proxy to a Durable Object MUST forward c.req.raw and MUST NOT use upgradeWebSocket from hono/cloudflare-workers.

TS-ERR-001.text: Service files MUST NOT import HTTPException or return HTTP status codes; they throw domain errors that the error middleware maps.

TS-ERR-002.text: The onError handler MUST map each domain error to a status and MUST log unmapped errors with message and stack before returning 500.

TS-SVC-001.text: Services MUST take a single ServiceContext argument rather than individual dependencies.

TS-SVC-002.text: Services MUST be stateless functions: no cached DB connections, no singletons.

TS-DB-001.text: postgres-js MUST NOT be constructed with prepare: false; Hyperdrive multiplexes prepared statements.

TS-DB-002.text: Inside db.transaction(), every statement MUST use the tx parameter; using the outer db bypasses the transaction.

TS-DB-003.text: Files under db/migrations/ are drizzle-kit output and MUST NOT be hand-edited.

TS-DB-004.text: Schema columns SHOULD be .notNull() unless genuinely nullable, timestamps SHOULD carry withTimezone, and indexes SHOULD be named idx_{table}_{columns}.

TS-AUTH-001.text: better-auth MUST be created per request; env bindings are request-scoped on Workers.

TS-AUTH-002.text: session.cookieCache MUST stay disabled while better-auth #4203 is open; enabling it logs users out at cache TTL.

TS-DO-001.text: Durable Object WebSockets MUST use this.ctx.acceptWebSocket(); server.accept() prevents hibernation and bills idle time.

TS-DO-002.text: Durable Object state read before an await MUST be re-read and version-compared after it; another event can mutate state mid-await.

TS-DO-003.text: Scheduled work in Durable Objects MUST use alarms, never setTimeout or setInterval.

TS-DO-004.text: setAlarm MUST be preceded by a getAlarm check; unconditional sets clobber pending alarms.

TS-DO-005.text: Durable Object state SHOULD be validated with its Zod schema on every read from storage.

TS-LOG-001.text: Production logs MUST be console.log(JSON.stringify({...})); plain-string logs are not indexed by Workers Logs.

TS-LOG-002.text: Error logs MUST include message and stack.

TS-TYPE-001.text: `any` MUST NOT be used; use unknown and narrow with Zod or a type guard.

TS-TYPE-002.text: A chained type assertion (`as unknown as T`) MUST carry a `SAFETY:` comment on the same or preceding line stating the invariant that makes the cast sound; test files are exempt. Prefer fixing the source type so the cast disappears.

RS-ERR-001.text: Non-test code MUST NOT call .unwrap() or .expect() on values that can fail from external input; return Err across the boundary. Clippy: unwrap_used, expect_used.

RS-ERR-002.text: An invariant-backed .expect() SHOULD cite the exact check in its message and sit within a few lines of that check.

RS-ERR-003.text: Float comparators MUST use total_cmp, never partial_cmp(..).unwrap(); NaN is a real input in audio/chroma data.

RS-ERR-004.text: No panic!, unreachable!, todo!, or unimplemented! outside #[cfg(test)]. Clippy: panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable (deny).

RS-ERR-005.text: Every #[wasm_bindgen]-exported function MUST return Result<T, JsValue> or a JSON String and never panic across the boundary.

RS-WASM-001.text: Boundary values containing a bool or Option<T> alongside other args in the same call MUST cross via serde_json strings, never serde_wasm_bindgen::to_value/from_value (workerd externref-aliasing corruption, already shipped once).

RS-WASM-002.text: Every exported function MUST carry a /// doc comment stating parameter and return shapes as the JS caller sees them.

RS-WASM-003.text: No convenience-overload exports whose only purpose is re-shuffling another export's argument shape.

RS-DEP-001.text: No Rc, RefCell, Arc, Mutex, or unsafe without a comment stating the specific ownership or aliasing problem being solved; unsafe_code is forbid crate-wide.

RS-DEP-002.text: A new #[allow(clippy::...)] MUST carry a same-line or preceding-line comment naming why the lint does not apply.

RS-STYLE-001.text: The repeated .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e.to_string())) boilerplate SHOULD collapse into one shared js_err free function per crate -- a function, not a trait or macro.

RS-STYLE-002.text: No speculative derives, traits, or generic parameters beyond a type's current usage; a trait with one implementor is unrequested flexibility.

WEB-ERR-001.text: A caught API/WebSocket/inference error MUST re-throw, set a caller-visible error state, or report to Sentry -- never silently return a default that masks the failure.

WEB-ERR-002.text: Every catch block SHOULD do one of: Sentry capture, explicit UI error state, or a comment naming the specific benign condition it swallows.

WEB-QUERY-001.text: Query keys MUST come from a shared per-domain factory, never string-literal arrays typed independently at call sites.

WEB-QUERY-002.text: Server state MUST NOT be copied into a zustand store; zustand holds client-only UI state, react-query owns caching and invalidation.

WEB-STATE-001.text: No useEffect + useState to derive a value that is a pure function of props or in-scope state; compute it during render.

WEB-STATE-002.text: useMemo/useCallback require a downstream dependency-array consumer or a comment citing a measured perf need; default is no memoization.

WEB-STATE-003.text: A new createContext requires a cross-tree concern with no natural prop path; do not add context to avoid passing two props through two components.

WEB-ROUTE-001.text: A route loader, if introduced, only prefetches/seeds the query cache via the same shared query options the component subscribes to; useLoaderData is never the sole data source while react-query is present.

WEB-UI-001.text: No any in component props or event handlers; use the concrete DOM/React event type. as never is permitted only as the documented Hono RPC escape hatch.

WEB-UI-002.text: No Tailwind arbitrary bracket values where a token equivalent exists in the @theme table; a genuinely one-off geometry value carries a comment.

WEB-UI-003.text: style={{...}} only for values computed at runtime; static inline styles bypass the token table.

WEB-A11Y-001.text: Every motion component or CSS animation with movement MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion, preferring an opacity fade over removal.

WEB-A11Y-002.text: Animation durations: press/hover 120-180ms, small state changes 180-260ms, user-initiated at most 300ms; ease-out entrances, ease-in exits, linear only for progress.

WEB-A11Y-003.text: Interactive targets MUST have at least a 32px hit area; icons inside them are aria-hidden and never the sole accessible label.

WEB-A11Y-004.text: New color/token pairs MUST pass WCAG AA in a real browser via bun run test:a11y; jsdom axe skips color-contrast.

WEB-COMPONENT-001.text: A component over ~300 non-test lines SHOULD be split unless it is one deep module with a single responsibility and a top-of-file comment saying so.

WEB-COMPONENT-002.text: No prop that no current caller passes, and no prop-count creep past ~6-8 without grouping; future flexibility is not a caller.

PY-ERR-001.text: No except Exception or bare except that neither re-raises nor routes through logging.exception; a deliberate broad catch carries # noqa: BLE001 plus a reason. Ruff: BLE001.

PY-ERR-002.text: No except-then-pass; re-raise, log with a reason, or delete the try/except.

PY-ERR-003.text: Re-raises inside except SHOULD chain with raise ... from e (or from None deliberately). Ruff: B904.

PY-ERR-004.text: Do not raise inside a try only to catch it in the same function's except; restructure as a direct conditional raise. Ruff: TRY301.

PY-002.text: No mutable default arguments; mutable class/dataclass defaults use field(default_factory=...). Ruff: B006, B008, RUF012.

PY-003.text: zip() over iterables whose lengths must match SHOULD pass strict=True; silent truncation is a silent fallback. Ruff: B905.

PY-004.text: No unused function/method parameters; remove them or prefix _. Ruff: ARG.

PY-005.text: File access SHOULD go through pathlib (Path.open(), not builtin open()/os.path). Ruff: PTH.

PY-006.text: No assign-then-immediately-return and no else after return/raise. Ruff: RET504, RET505, RET506, RET508.

PY-008.text: No stale # noqa suppressing a violation that no longer fires. Ruff: RUF100.

PY-009.text: New code SHOULD use numpy.random.default_rng(seed) passed explicitly, never global np.random state. Ruff: NPY002.

PY-ML-001.text: Code handling missing transcription, audio, or ground truth MUST raise a named exception; never substitute a weaker artifact and never return a sentinel a downstream aggregator could average into a metric.

PY-ML-002.text: Entry points SHOULD default filesystem paths from model/src/paths.py rather than re-deriving their own __file__ anchors.

PY-ML-003.text: No new @dataclass config object for a script or function with exactly one call site; keyword arguments or module constants suffice until a second caller exists.

TS-FILE-001.text: Files SHOULD be kebab-case and route modules SHOULD use a named {xxxRoutes} export, not a default export.
